messages:
incident-bot: PAGERS -> Active: Latency surge detected in eu-west edge lane affecting Economy tier. Error spike 502/504 and p50 latency up ~3.2x. @oncall-lee paged (severity: high). Incident ID: IN-2026-3076543210
oncall-lee: Acknowledged. I'm taking it. Looking at routing metrics now. Any customer impact notes?
sre-anna: Seeing increased queueing on edge-proxy pods in eu-west-1. Economy tier QPS up 40% vs baseline; premium stable. Some autoscale thrash on economy nodes. Errors correlate with a downstream model cache fail.
infra-jay: Filed a quick infra alert — kube evictions on edge-pool-economy-1. Logs show OOM killed sidecars intermittently.
eng-runtime: Rolling logs show KV cache miss rate spiking. Might be a bad cache key eviction pattern after last rollout to hashing function.
cust-success-maya: Heads up — two customers (fin-app and travelly) reported 500s on embeddings calls. They're flagged as mid-tier; may need targeted notice.
oncall-lee: Plan: 1) Immediately deprioritize Economy lane for eu-west via smart-routing (shift 60% of economy -> regional-economy-fallback) 2) Apply temporary quota cap for anonymous/free accounts in eu-west 3) Disable economy-prefetch feature for 30m 4) Pager to infra and runtime for rollback if errors increase. Executing step 1 now.
oncall-lee: /api call: curl -s -X POST "https://control-plane/api/v1/routing/adjust" -d '{"region":"eu-west","policy":"deprioritize","target":"economy","weight_shift":60}'  --response 202
incident-bot: Control-plane accepted change (job 9876). Smart-routing policy update propagating.
eng-runtime: Seeing drop in queue depth for economy nodes within 20s. p50 latency for premium unchanged. Good so far.
infra-jay: Applying quota caps: anonymous_qps -> 10r/s, anon-burst -> 30. Patch pushed to rate-limiter config.
cust-success-maya: Notifying affected customers via banner template C1. Drafted message, waiting approval.
product-raj: Hold on disabling economy-prefetch until we see full propagation; prefetch helps cold starts for some customers — might increase latency for those who stay in economy fallback. Can we toggle only in eu-west-economy pool?
oncall-lee: Good call. Changing to targeted toggle for eu-west-economy only. /feature-toggle disable economy-prefetch --region eu-west --note "mitigation IN-3076543210"
eng-runtime: Confirmed: economy-prefetch disabled in eu-west-economy. Cold start errors rose marginally but overall 502s down 18%.
sre-anna: Monitoring for 10m. If error rate < baseline*1.2 and latency improves -> keep. If not, revert policy and route more traffic to dedicated capacity.
infra-jay: If we need more headroom, we can spin a small emergency pool (edge-econ-burst-2) for 15m. Prep'd autoscale script.
oncall-lee: Customer impact assessment: ~3% of total requests affected; of those, ~60% saw retries handled by fallback, ~40% got transient 5xx (most resolved by client retry). Two customers escalated; CS has initial notice.
cust-success-maya: Sending the prepared banner now. Also opening support tickets for fin-app and travelly with status + mitigation ETA.
product-raj: Postmortem action: add canary for cache-hash rollout and alert on cache miss rate delta > 10% per region.
oncall-lee: For now mitigation looks effective: p50 latency for eu-west economy down from 3.2x -> 1.25x vs baseline, 502 rate down 70%. Keeping targeted deprioritization and quota caps for 30m then reassess. Will update in 15m or earlier if changes.
incident-bot: Incident IN-2026-3076543210 -> status: mitigation in progress. Next update by 3076543300. (reaction :rotating_light: )
